name: @activepieces/piece-circle
description: Circle.so is a platform for creating and managing communities.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

create_post.name: create_post
create_post.description: Creates a new post in a specific space.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

text_body.description: Simple plain text content for the post. Used if 'Tiptap Body JSON' is not provided.

tiptap_body_json.description: Full TipTap JSON object for the post body. If provided, 'Post Body (Plain Text)' is ignored.

published_at.description: If status is 'scheduled', provide the future date and time for publishing.

skip_notifications.description: Prevent notifications from being sent for this post?

user_email.description: Email of an existing community member to create this post as. If empty, posts as the authenticated admin.

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a new post into a given Circle space, accepting body content as either plain text or a full TipTap JSON document (JSON wins if both are supplied). Use to programmatically add community content; status can be draft, published, or scheduled (a scheduled status needs a future publish time). Creates a new post on each call, so it is not idempotent.

create_comment.name: create_comment
create_comment.description: Creates a new comment on a post.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.
You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

parent_comment_id.description: ID of the comment to reply to. Leave empty if not a reply.

skip_notifications.description: Skip sending notifications for this comment?

aiMetadata.description: Adds a comment to a Circle post, identified by its post ID. Use to reply within a discussion; supplying a parent comment ID makes it a threaded reply rather than a top-level comment. Posts a new comment on each call, so it is not idempotent.

add_member_to_space.name: add_member_to_space
add_member_to_space.description: Add an existing member to a specific space by their email.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

email.description: The email address of the member to add to the space.

aiMetadata.description: Grants an existing community member access to a specific Circle space, matched by their email address. Use to expand a member into additional spaces; the member must already exist in the community. Effectively keyed on the space/email pair, so re-running with the same inputs is safe.

find_member_by_email.name: find_member_by_email
find_member_by_email.description: Finds a community member by their email address.

email.description: The email address of the member to find.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single community member by their exact email address. Use to resolve an email into a member record (e.g. to obtain the member ID) before acting on them. Read-only and idempotent.

get_post_details.name: get_post_details
get_post_details.description: Retrieves the complete details of a specific post.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.
You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of a single Circle post by its post ID. Use to read a known post's content and metadata. Read-only and idempotent.

get_member_details.name: get_member_details
get_member_details.description: Fetches the full profile details for a specific community member.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full profile of a single community member by their member ID. Use when you already have the member ID (e.g. from Find Member by Email) and need their complete profile data. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_post_created.name: new_post_created
new_post_created.description: Triggers when a new post is created in a specific space.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to **Settings->Developers->Tokens**.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new published post appears in the selected Circle space. Each event represents one newly published post in that space.

new_member_added.name: new_member_added
new_member_added.description: Triggers when a new member is added to the community.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new member joins the Circle community. Each event represents one newly added community member, across all spaces.
